newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Senate vote on privatization bill delayed.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Senate vote on privatization bill delayed.

text.p: A vote on a bill to give Brazil's Congress power to remove companies from the country's privatization program was delayed until Thursday, a senator who wrote the bill said.
Sen. Jose Eduardo Dutra said the upper house would begin discussing the bill later on Tuesday, but no vote would take place until Thursday.
Dutra's bill seeks principally to block the privatization of mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD).

The bill was defeated last month in a Senate committee, but nonetheless reached the floor of the upper house thanks to a loophold in Congressional rules. Sources said government leaders would seek to stall the bill by sending it to another committee.
